{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes (especially after sentiment > 0.00).",
    "Adjust downward if sentiment is negative (sentiment < 0.00) or transitions to negative, indicating bearish momentum.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is significantly above recent 5-day average, reduce by 5-10% for next period.",
    "Increase downward bias when true outcome is consistently below forecast over 3+ consecutive days (indicating overconfidence).",
    "If sentiment is positive but forecast is still high, reduce forecast by 3-5% to avoid overreaction to bullish sentiment.",
    "For long-term (30-day) forecasts, apply a 10-15% downward correction if true outcome is below 70% of forecast range over 5+ days.",
    "When sentiment is neutral (0.00) and forecast is high, apply a 5% downward adjustment to avoid false optimism."
  ]
}
